entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-07
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • `dotnet workload list` doesn't show exact SDK for "Installation Source" #31669
  • dotnet compiler crashes when compiling inside a sandbox #31668
  • Add InstalledWorkloadPacks to WorkloadHistoryRecord #35452
  • #:package directive alters behavior of Directory.GetCurrentDirectory() #53711
